what: Charles Schwab is the largest US retail brokerage. It holds client investments, earns interest on client cash, manages funds and serves independent financial advisers.
customers: Individual investors and independent advisers in the US.
money: interest earned on client cash held at its bank
order flow, commissions, bank deposit fees
moat: Enormous scale, low prices and a trusted brand that keep attracting client assets.
risks: Clients moving cash to higher-yield products
opportunities: Revenue grew about 22% last year with a 37% net margin
Analysts see about 27% upside from current levels
Client cash moving back from money funds into its bank would lift interest income
watch: Net new client assets and the level of client cash held at the bank.
